changelog: Fixes the watch history import, which failed immediately on Jellyfin 10.11.11 with a MissingMethodException. The way to list user accounts changed inside the 10.11 patch series - 10.11.0 exposes a Users property and 10.11.11 replaced it with a GetUsers method, and the two are mutually exclusive - so a plugin built against one crashes on the other. The engine now asks in a way that works on either, and falls back to reporting no users rather than throwing if a future version renames it again. Also fixes the Recompute queue tile on the Users page, which showed -1 because reading the queue length threw instead of returning a number. This is a beta release.
